root_text: Protect yourself & others from HMPV! 🛡️ Wash hands often 🧼,cover coughs & sneezes with your elbow 🤧,and avoid close contact with sick people. If you're feeling unwell, stay home to prevent spread.Let's keep our community healthy! 💪
